chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.4.example.1.zh: 小孩子每天最好至少睡十小时。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.4.example.1.en: Children should sleep at least 10 hours a day.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.meaning.zh: 转述要求、命令或禁止的内容
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.meaning.en: Restatement of requirements, orders or prohibitions

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ように＋言う・注意する等；被动形式为「ように言われる」「ように注意される」。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.connection.en: Verb dictionary/nai-form + ように + 言う・注意する, etc. Passive forms: ように言われる and ように注意される.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.note.zh: 转述他人要求做某事或不要做某事。本课不是表示目的的「ように」。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.note.en: Repeals a request to do something or not to do something. This course is not "ように " for the purpose.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.example.0.zh: 被要求至少吃十根香蕉。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.example.0.en: He was asked to eat at least 10 bananas.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.example.1.zh: 学生们被老师多次提醒不要迟到。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.5.example.1.en: Students were reminded repeatedly by their teachers not to be late.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.meaning.zh: 原先没有或看不见的事物逐渐出现
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.meaning.en: Things that never existed or could not be seen gradually emerge.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.note.zh: 本课表示显现、出现，不是单纯向说话人方向移动。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.note.en: This course shows, shows up and does not simply move in the direction of those who speak.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.example.0.zh: 努力逐渐以具体成果的形式显现出来。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.example.0.en: Efforts are gradually emerging in the form of concrete results.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.example.1.zh: 到了春天，树木会长出许多新芽。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.6.example.1.en: By spring, trees will grow many new buds.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.connection.zh: 接续词连接前后句；副词修饰动作、状态或程度。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.connection.en: Connection words connect to the first and second sentences; adverbs modify actions, states or degrees.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.note.zh: 接续词：だから（所以）、すると（于是）、したがって（因此）、そのため（为此／因此）、しかし（但是）、だが（但是）。副词：まず（首先）、再び（再次）、ようやく（终于）、たっぷり（充分地）、大量に（大量地）、さらに（更加／进一步）、はっきり（清楚地）。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.note.en: Structure word: だから (So) すると (thus) したがって (as a result), そのため (for this/as a result), しかし (But), だが (but) Adverbs: まず (first of all), 再び (Again), ようやく # At last # たっぷり (fullness), 大量に (many of them), さらに (more/further), はっきり (clears throat)

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.example.0.zh: 反复练习。这样一来，就能赢得更多比赛。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.example.0.en: Rehearsal. So you can win more games.

chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.example.1.zh: 大量吃被称为“ちゃんこ”的相扑料理。
chukyu.lesson.7.grammar.7.example.1.en: Eat large quantities of the sumo meal called ちゃんこ.

chukyu.lesson.7.exerciseInstructions.zh: 第1—4题：共にする、重ねる、つく、与える、流す，填入适当形式。第5—7题：再び、はっきり、ようやく、大量に。
chukyu.lesson.7.exerciseInstructions.en: For questions 1–4, use the appropriate form of 共にする、重ねる、つく、与える、流す. For questions 5–7, choose from 再び、はっきり、ようやく、大量に.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.0.note.zh: 「背中を流す」是帮别人擦洗后背的表达。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.0.note.en: 「背中を流す」means washing someone else's back.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.1.note.zh: 「与えないでください」表示请不要喂食；括号后已有ない。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.1.note.en: 与えないでください means please do not feed them. The prompt already includes ない after the blank.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.2.note.zh: 反复训练用「練習を重ねる」。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.2.note.en: Use 練習を重ねる for repeated practice.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.3.note.zh: 「食事を共にする」表示一起吃饭。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.3.note.en: 食事を共にする means to eat together.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.4.note.zh: 活动后产生了大量垃圾。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.4.note.en: The event resulted in a large amount of garbage.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.5.note.zh: 忙碌之后好不容易空闲下来，用ようやく。
chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.5.note.en: Busy after a while, it's not easy to get free with ようやく.

chukyu.lesson.7.exercise.6.note.en: Use 再び to say someone won the championship again this year.

chukyu.question.l7-g1.explanation.zh: 「Nだらけ」表示满是某物，常用于不理想的状态。
chukyu.question.l7-g1.explanation.en: Nだらけ means covered or filled with something, often in an undesirable state.

chukyu.question.l7-g2.explanation.zh: 「練習しないと、上達しないからだ」表示因为不练习就不会进步。
chukyu.question.l7-g2.explanation.en: 練習しないと、上達しないからだ explains that improvement is impossible without practice.

chukyu.question.l7-g3.explanation.zh: 动词辞书形＋たびに：聞くたびに。
chukyu.question.l7-g3.explanation.en: verb dictionary form + たびに: 聞くたびに.

chukyu.question.l7-g5.explanation.zh: な形容词接「なのに加えて」：静かなのに加えて。这里の是名词化，不是转折的のに。
chukyu.question.l7-g5.explanation.en: な adjective by "なのに加えて": 静かなのに加えて. Here the の is nounized and not a rolling のに.

chukyu.question.l7-g6.explanation.zh: 数量后面的「は」表示最低数量：至少30分钟。
chukyu.question.l7-g6.explanation.en: After the number, "は" means minimum: at least 30 minutes.

chukyu.question.l7-g7.explanation.zh: 转述禁止的内容用动词ない形＋ように言われる。
chukyu.question.l7-g7.explanation.en: To report a prohibition, use the verb's nai-form＋ように言われる.

chukyu.question.l7-g8.explanation.zh: 转述要求做某事，用辞书形＋ように言われる。
chukyu.question.l7-g8.explanation.en: To report an instruction to do something, use the dictionary form＋ように言われる.

chukyu.question.l7-g9.option.1.zh: 原先看不见的事物出现

chukyu.question.l7-g9.explanation.zh: 本课的「てくる」表示原先没有或看不见的事物出现。
chukyu.question.l7-g9.explanation.en: The subject 'てくる' means something that was not or could not be seen.

chukyu.question.l7-g10.explanation.zh: 「すると」连接前后句，表示这样一来就产生后面的结果。
chukyu.question.l7-g10.explanation.en: すると connects to the following sentence, meaning that it produces later results.

word.2956.meaning.en: to keep in mind; to bear in mind

word.2972.meaning.en: point (of a story, argument, etc.); key point

word.2975.meaning.en: lack of expression; lack of emotion

chukyu.word.2977.note.zh: 背もたれに寄りかかる：倚靠椅背。
chukyu.word.2977.note.en: 背もたれに寄りかかる: lean against the backrest.

word.2978.meaning.en: to lean against; to recline on

chukyu.word.2978.note.zh: 背もたれに寄りかかる：靠在椅背上。
chukyu.word.2978.note.en: 背もたれに寄りかかる: lean against the backrest.

word.2979.meaning.zh: 压迫感；令人畏惧的气势

chukyu.word.2979.note.zh: 威圧感を与える：给人压迫感。
chukyu.word.2979.note.en: 威圧感を与える: to make someone feel intimidated.

chukyu.word.2982.note.en: 状況に合う: suit the situation.

chukyu.word.2983.note.en: This lesson refers to the inner human being.

chukyu.word.2985.note.zh: 第一印象を左右する：影响第一印象。
chukyu.word.2985.note.en: 第一印象を左右する: to influence a first impression.

word.3001.meaning.en: place where one works; construction site

word.3004.meaning.en: quality (of a product or a service)

word.3006.meaning.en: to put on airs; to throw one's weight about

word.3025.meaning.en: to recommend (someone to do); to advise

word.3033.meaning.zh: 讨论战术的时间；发言准备时间
word.3033.meaning.en: strategy break; time to prepare an argument

word.3037.meaning.en: to compare (e.g. notes); to exchange (e.g. views, opinions)

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.connection.zh: 普通形＋にすぎない；名词／な形容词的だ改为「である」或省略：N（である）にすぎない。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.connection.en: Plain Form + にすぎない; noun / な adjective for だ read "である" or omitted: N(である) にすぎない.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.note.zh: 强调数量、程度或性质有限，相当于“仅此而已”。与表示“过于……”的「すぎる」不同。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.note.en: The emphasis is limited in number, degree or nature, which amounts to " nothing more than this " , unlike "すぎる" for "excessive".

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.0.zh: 根据语言因素判断对方的人只占区区百分之几。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.0.en: Only a few per cent of the districts are judged on the basis of language.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.1.zh: 他的演讲只不过是模仿了别人。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.1.en: His speech was just an imitation of others.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.2.zh: 兼职收入每月仅两万日元。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.0.example.2.en: Part-time income is only 20,000 yen per month.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.connection.zh: 名词＋さえ＋动词ば形／い形容词ければ／な形容词词干＋なら等。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.connection.en: Noun＋さえ＋verb in the ba-form, i-adjective with ければ, or na-adjective stem＋なら, etc.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.note.zh: 假设唯一的必要条件，强调满足这个条件即可。例：天気さえよければ、体さえ丈夫なら。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.note.en: Presents a single necessary condition and emphasizes that meeting it is sufficient. Examples: 天気さえよければ、体さえ丈夫なら.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.example.0.en: Just keep an eye on it.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.example.1.zh: 只要天气好，从这里就能看到岛。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.example.1.en: As long as the weather is good, you can see the island from here.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.example.2.zh: 只要身体健康，什么事都能做。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.1.example.2.en: You can do anything as long as you're healthy.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.meaning.zh: 条件、限定与强调的区分
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.meaning.en: Distinction between conditions, limitations and emphasis

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.connection.zh: Nさえ～ば：只要；Nしか＋否定：仅仅、只；Nこそ：正是、才是。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.connection.en: Nさえ～ば: as long as; Nしか＋negative: only; Nこそ: precisely; the very one.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.note.zh: 本课「さえ」与条件表达搭配；「しか」必须与否定形式呼应；「こそ」突出强调对象。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.note.en: This lesson "さえ" matches conditional expressions; "しか" must respond to negative forms; and "こそ" highlights objects.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.example.0.zh: 只要能读平假名，就能读这本图画书。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.example.0.en: If you can read Hiragana, you can read it.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.example.2.zh: 有学生认为学习汉字才是最重要的。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.2.example.2.en: There are students who think learning Kanji is the most important thing.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.meaning.en: It's not... it's just; it's not necessarily...

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.connection.zh: 普通形＋というものではない／というものでもない；名词／な形容词可接「（だ）というものではない」。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.connection.en: Plain form + というものではない／というものでもない; nouns and na-adjectives may take （だ）というものではない.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.note.zh: 否定简单、绝对的判断，表示并不是任何时候都必然如此，类似「わけではない／わけでもない」。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.note.en: Rejecting simple, absolute judgements means that this is not always necessary, like "わけではない/ わけでもない " .

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.0.zh: 并不是只注意穿着就行。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.0.en: It's not just about wearing it.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.1.zh: 外语也不是住到那个国家就一定能学好。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.1.en: If you don't live in that country, you can learn it.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.2.zh: 名牌大学毕业的人也不一定优秀。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.3.example.2.en: Also, those who graduate from famous universities are not necessarily excellent.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.meaning.en: It may be; I'm afraid it will...

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.connection.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋かねない

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.note.zh: 表示由于某种原因可能产生不好的结果。不是“不能”的意思；注意与「かねる」区分。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.note.en: This means that a bad result may occur for some reason. It is not meant to be "can't"; attention is distinguished from "かねる".

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.0.zh: 过于倚靠椅背，可能会给人压迫感。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.0.en: Too much reliance on the back of a chair may create a sense of oppression.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.1.zh: 说那样的话，可能会招致误解。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.1.en: In that case, it might be misleading.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.2.zh: 吃饭时不考虑营养均衡，可能会生病。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.4.example.2.en: Eating without taking into account nutritional balance may become ill.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.connection.zh: 动词／い形容词普通形＋ものの；な形容词＋な／である＋ものの；名词＋である＋ものの。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.connection.en: verb/ い Subjective plain form + ものの ； な Subjective + な ／ である ＋ ものの ;noun+ である ＋ ものの 。

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.note.zh: 承认前项事实，但后项情况与通常预期不同，相当于「けれども」，多用于书面表达。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.note.en: Recognition of the previous fact, but the latter situation is different from normal expectations and amounts to " けれども " , which is mostly used for written expression.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.0.zh: 虽说“人的内在很重要”，外表和说话方式仍会影响第一印象。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.0.en: Although “the intrinsic importance of the human person”, appearances and ways of speaking can affect the first impression.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.1.zh: 现在的公司虽然工资不太高，但人际关系好，所以我很满意。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.1.en: I am satisfied with the fact that companies today are not well paid, but they have good relationships.

chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.2.zh: 他虽然措辞礼貌，但态度不好，因此给人的印象很差。
chukyu.lesson.8.grammar.5.example.2.en: He was polite in his language, but not well-meaning and therefore gave a poor impression.

chukyu.lesson.8.exerciseInstructions.zh: 第1—3题：感じる、合わせる、決定する、寄りかかる，填入适当形式。第4—7题：無表情、姿勢、動作、信頼、中身。
chukyu.lesson.8.exerciseInstructions.en: Questions 1-3: 感じる, 合わせる, 決定する, 寄りかかる, in proper form. Questions 4-7: No expression, position, action, letter, middle body.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.0.note.zh: 「目を合わせる」表示对视；连接后句用て形。
chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.0.note.en: 目を合わせる means to make eye contact. Use the te-form to connect to the next clause.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.1.note.zh: 「寄りかからないでください」表示请不要倚靠；括号后已有ない。
chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.1.note.en: 寄りかからないでください means please do not lean against it. The prompt already includes ない after the blank.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.2.note.zh: 「決定している」表示依据数据作决定。
chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.2.note.en: 「決定している」means decisions are based on the data.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.3.note.zh: 「前かがみの姿勢」指身体前倾的姿势。
chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.3.note.en: 前かがみの姿勢 means a posture with the body leaning forward.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.4.note.en: Here's a comparison of appearances and interiors.

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.5.note.zh: 动物幼崽的动作很可爱。

chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.6.note.zh: 因为面无表情，很难判断有没有干劲。
chukyu.lesson.8.exercise.6.note.en: It's hard to tell if you're motivated because you don't have a face.

chukyu.question.l8-g1.option.3.en: The number of participants is not yet decided.

chukyu.question.l8-g1.explanation.zh: 「にすぎない」强调数量有限：仅仅10人。
chukyu.question.l8-g1.explanation.en: にすぎない limits the quantity: only ten people.

chukyu.question.l8-g2.explanation.zh: 普通形＋にすぎない：話したにすぎない，表示只是讲了听到的内容。
chukyu.question.l8-g2.explanation.en: plain Form + にすぎない: 話したにすぎない indicates that only what has been heard is said.

chukyu.question.l8-g3.explanation.zh: な形容词条件形用なら：丈夫なら。
chukyu.question.l8-g3.explanation.en: な adjective condition in なら: 丈夫なら.

chukyu.question.l8-g4.prompt.instruction.zh: 表达“只要天气好，从这里就能看到山”
chukyu.question.l8-g4.prompt.instruction.en: Express “As long as the weather is good, you can see the mountain from here.”

chukyu.question.l8-g4.explanation.zh: さえ～ば表示只要满足条件即可。よければ表示天气好的条件；悪ければ改变为天气坏，よくても／悪くても是让步表达，均不符合题意。
chukyu.question.l8-g4.explanation.en: さえ — ば indicates that the condition is met. よければ means the condition of a good weather; 悪ければ changes to bad weather, and よくても / 悪くても is an expression of compromise and does not correspond to the issue.

chukyu.question.l8-g5.explanation.zh: 「しか」与否定呼应，表示限定：只会读平假名。
chukyu.question.l8-g5.explanation.en: "しか" and negative echoes are limited: only hiragana is read.

chukyu.question.l8-g6.prompt.instruction.zh: 強調「努力才是最重要的」
chukyu.question.l8-g6.prompt.instruction.en: Emphasize that effort is the most important thing.

chukyu.question.l8-g6.explanation.zh: 「こそ」用于突出强调：努力才是最重要的。
chukyu.question.l8-g6.explanation.en: "こそ" is used to highlight that efforts are the most important.

chukyu.question.l8-g7.explanation.zh: 「というものではない」否定简单绝对的判断，并非越贵就一定越好。
chukyu.question.l8-g7.explanation.en: The "というものではない" negatives the simple absolute judgement, not necessarily the more expensive it is.

chukyu.question.l8-g8.explanation.zh: ます形去ます＋かねない：招きかねない。
chukyu.question.l8-g8.explanation.en: Masu-stem + かねない: 招きかねない.

chukyu.question.l8-g9.explanation.zh: 「かねない」表示不好的结果有可能发生。
chukyu.question.l8-g9.explanation.en: "かねない" means that bad results can happen.

chukyu.question.l8-g10.explanation.zh: な形容词接ものの用「な」或「である」：丁寧なものの。
chukyu.question.l8-g10.explanation.en: な adjective receives ものの using "な" or "である": 丁寧なものの.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.0.logic.zh: 把某件事说成普遍规律、人之常情或理所当然的道理。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.0.logic.en: To describe something as universal, human or natural.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.0.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形・い形容词・な形容词な＋ものだ

n2.day1-mono.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 不是在回忆。看到现在形，通常是在讲“世上的事本来就是这样”。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.0.contrast.en: It's not a memory. Seeing it now, it's usually like, "That's what happens in the world."

n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.logic.zh: 回望过去反复做过的事，事实之外还带着怀念或感慨。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.logic.en: Looking back at what has been done and repeated in the past, there are memories or feelings beyond the truth.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 「～ていた」只客观描述过去持续或习惯；たものだ多了一层“想当年”的回忆滤镜。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.contrast.en: ～ていた objectively describes a past habit or continuing action; たものだ adds nostalgic recollection.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.translation.zh: 想当年，我小时候可常在这条河里游泳。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.1.translation.en: I used to swim in this river when I was a kid.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.logic.zh: 为已经发生的结果补充原因，常带解释、辩解或希望对方体谅的语气。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.logic.en: To add to the reasons for the results that have already taken place, a tone of explanation, justification or comprehension is often used.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.connection.zh: 普通形＋ものだから（な形容词／名词：な＋ものだから）
n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.connection.en: plain form＋ものだから（na-adjective／noun：な＋ものだから）

n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 「から」只是中性说明原因；ものだから更像“我是有原因的嘛”，常用于解释失误。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.contrast.en: "から" is merely a neutral explanation of why; ものだから is more like "I have a reason for it," often used to explain errors.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.translation.zh: 因为会议拖得太久了嘛，所以回晚了。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.2.translation.en: The meeting was too late, so it was too late.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.logic.zh: A 的确成立，但现实中的 B 没有按预期发展；语气较书面、客观。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.logic.en: A Yes, but in reality B has not developed as intended; the tone is more written and objective.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.connection.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な・である／名词＋である＋ものの
n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.connection.en: verb・i-adjectiveplain form／na-adjective stem＋な・である／noun＋である＋ものの

n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 「ものを」带遗憾或责怪；ものの只是承认 A 后平静地转向不符合预期的 B。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.contrast.en: 「ものを」expresses regret or blame. ものの simply acknowledges A before introducing an unexpected B.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.translation.zh: 虽说考试过了，可会话我还是没底。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.3.translation.en: Even though I passed the exam, I still had no conversation.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.logic.zh: 「できるものなら」假设难实现的愿望；「しようものなら」假设一旦那样做就会有严重后果。先看前面的动词形式。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.logic.en: できるものなら expresses a wish whose realization is difficult. しようものなら uses the volitional form to warn of a serious consequence if someone attempts the action. These patterns have different meanings.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.connection.zh: 可能形＋ものなら；意向形＋ものなら（＝～ようものなら）
n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.connection.en: Potential form + ものなら; volitional form + ものなら (= ～ようものなら).

n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 戻れるものなら戻りたい＝能回去就想回去；秘密を話そうものなら大変だ＝要是泄密可就糟了。不能只记成一个泛泛的“如果”。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.contrast.en: 戻れるものなら戻りたい means wanting to return if it were possible. 秘密を話そうものなら大変だ warns of serious consequences if the secret is revealed. Do not reduce both to a generic if.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.translation.zh: 人生要是真能重来，我一定多读点书。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.4.translation.en: I'm sure I'll read a lot more if I can get my life back.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.logic.zh: 本来有更好的选择或本应出现另一结果，现实却偏离了；说话人带遗憾、埋怨。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.logic.en: There was a better choice or another result, and reality deviated; speaking with regret and resentment.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.connection.zh: 普通形＋ものを（常见：～ば／たらいいものを）
n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.connection.en: plain form＋ものを（common：～ば／たらいいものを）

n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 「ものの」重在客观转折；ものを重在“你明明可以那样，怎么偏偏这样”的情绪。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.contrast.en: "ものの" focuses on an objective turn; "ものを" focuses on the "how you can do that."

n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.translation.zh: 明明跟我说一声我就会帮忙，他却偏偏一个人全做了。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.5.translation.en: You told me I'd help, but he did it all by himself.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.logic.zh: 从常识、道德或做人道理出发劝诫，而不是发布一条硬性禁令。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.logic.en: It is common sense, morality or human reason to counsel rather than to impose a mandatory ban.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.connection.zh: 动词辞书形＋ものではない
n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.connection.en: verb dictionary form＋ものではない

n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.contrast.zh: 「べきではない」像理性规范；ものではない更像长辈说“做人可不能这样”。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.contrast.en: "べきではない" is like a rational norm; ものではない is more like an elder saying, "You can't be human."

n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.translation.zh: 做人哪能拿别人的失败取笑。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.6.translation.en: You can't make fun of someone else's failure.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.logic.zh: 对一件事作评价或下定义，强调它才真正配得上某个名称。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.logic.en: An evaluation or definition of a matter emphasizes that it really deserves a name.

n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.connection.zh: 普通形／名词＋というものだ

n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.contrast.zh: 普通「という」只是引用或命名；というものだ带说话人的判断，常译成“这才算得上”。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.contrast.en: Normal "という" is merely a reference or a name; というものだ with the judgement of the person who speaks is often translated into "that's what counts."

n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.translation.zh: 朋友有难时伸手帮一把，这才叫友情。
n2.day1-mono.grammar.7.translation.en: A friend gives a hand when he's in trouble. That's friendship.

n2.day1-mono.question.0.explanation.zh: 「～たものだ」是在带着感慨回忆过去反复发生的事。这里不是单纯说“聊过”，而是“想当年，我们常常聊到天亮”。
n2.day1-mono.question.0.explanation.en: ～たものだ recalls repeated past events with emotion: we used to talk until dawn, rather than simply having talked once.

n2.day1-mono.question.1.explanation.zh: 这里说的是普遍规律：到了新环境，谁一开始都会不安。中文的“人嘛，本来就……”最贴近这种常理语气。
n2.day1-mono.question.1.explanation.en: And here's the general rule: when we get to a new environment, everyone starts to worry. The Chinese word "people," it's the most common tone.

n2.day1-mono.question.2.explanation.zh: 说话人在解释没能及时回复的原因，带一点“是因为会议拖长了嘛”的说明、辩解语气。
n2.day1-mono.question.2.explanation.en: The speaker explained the reasons for the failure to respond in a timely manner, with an explanation and justification “because the meeting was prolonged”.

n2.day1-mono.question.3.explanation.zh: 合格这件事成立，但会话仍没自信，结果与预期有落差。「ものの」是较客观的逆接。 补充：ものを也能表示“明明已经通过”，但带更强的不满或遗憾；ものの是较中性的转折。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「ものの」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day1-mono.question.3.explanation.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day1-mono.question.3.anchor.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

n2.day1-mono.question.4.explanation.zh: “能休一周”在现实中不太容易实现，因此用「ものなら」表达“要是真能做到的话”。
n2.day1-mono.question.4.explanation.en: "A week off" is not easy to achieve in reality, so it's called "ものなら" and "if you can do it."

n2.day1-mono.question.5.explanation.zh: 本来只要商量一下就能帮忙，他却偏偏独自熬夜做完。这里有明显的遗憾和埋怨，所以用「ものを」。
n2.day1-mono.question.5.explanation.en: He could have helped if he had just talked about it, but he did it alone. There were obvious regrets and grievances, so use "ものを. "

n2.day1-mono.question.6.explanation.zh: 这不是法律禁令，而是在讲做人做事的常理：哪能不听解释就单方面责备别人。
n2.day1-mono.question.6.explanation.en: This is not a legal prohibition; it is the common sense to do things: to blame others unilaterally if they do not listen to an explanation.

n2.day1-mono.question.7.explanation.zh: 说话人在对“真正的友情”作评价、下定义。「というものだ」最自然地对应“这才叫真正的友情”。
n2.day1-mono.question.7.explanation.en: The talker evaluates and defines "real friendship". "というものだ" most naturally corresponds to "that's what true friendship is."

n2.day1-mono.question.8.explanation.zh: 「昔」「祭りになると」共同提示过去反复出现的景象，句中还有回忆和感慨的味道。
n2.day1-mono.question.8.explanation.en: 昔 and 祭りになると together evoke a recurring past scene, with a sense of recollection and emotion.

n2.day1-mono.question.9.explanation.zh: 练习了很多次，但正式场合仍说不出话，是客观的预期落差；没有责怪谁的情绪，因此选「ものの」。 补充：ものを可强调努力付诸东流的遗憾；ものの只是承认练习过但结果不理想。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「ものの」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day1-mono.question.9.explanation.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day1-mono.question.9.anchor.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

n2.day1-mono.question.10.explanation.zh: 正在为“忘带资料”解释原因：因为早上慌慌张张出门了嘛。这个解释语气正是「ものだから」。
n2.day1-mono.question.10.explanation.en: The explanation for "forgetting information" is because it's open in the morning. It's called "ものだから".

n2.day1-mono.question.11.explanation.zh: 回到过去几乎无法实现，所以不是普通的“如果”，而是带强烈愿望的“要是真能回去的话”。
n2.day1-mono.question.11.explanation.en: Returning to the past is almost impossible, so it is not the ordinary “if” but the “if it is possible to go back” with a strong desire.

n2.day10-change.grammar.0.logic.zh: A 一点点变化，B 也自然跟着发生程度性变化。两边通常都不是一次性动作。
n2.day10-change.grammar.0.logic.en: A little change, B naturally follows a change of degree. Neither side is usually a one-time action.

n2.day10-change.grammar.0.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／表变化的名词＋につれて
n2.day10-change.grammar.0.connection.en: verb dictionary form／change-denoting noun＋につれて

n2.day10-change.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 最贴近中文“越来越……”的自然关联。后项不宜是说话人的意志、命令或一次性决定。
n2.day10-change.grammar.0.contrast.en: It is not appropriate for the latter to be the will, an order or a one-time decision of the person who speaks.

n2.day10-change.grammar.0.translation.zh: 随着日语越来越好，和日本人聊天也越来越有意思。
n2.day10-change.grammar.0.translation.en: As Japanese became better, talking to the Japanese became more interesting.

n2.day10-change.grammar.1.logic.zh: A 按某个方向或阶段推进，B 也依照这一趋势逐步改变。语气比「につれて」稍书面。
n2.day10-change.grammar.1.logic.en: A moves in a certain direction or stage, and B gradually changes according to this trend. The tone is slightly more written than "につれて. "

n2.day10-change.grammar.1.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋にしたがって
n2.day10-change.grammar.1.connection.en: verb dictionary form／noun＋にしたがって

n2.day10-change.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 「にしたがって」还可以表示“依照规则／指示”；「につれて」主要是两种变化的自然关联。
n2.day10-change.grammar.1.contrast.en: The term "にしたがって" may also mean "in accordance with the rules/directives" and "につれて" is essentially a natural connection between two changes.

n2.day10-change.grammar.1.translation.zh: 随着年龄增长，人们会逐渐更关心健康。
n2.day10-change.grammar.1.translation.en: As age grows, people become more concerned about health.

n2.day10-change.grammar.2.anchor.en: And along with it, it happens.

n2.day10-change.grammar.2.logic.zh: A 往往是规模较大的社会、组织或制度变化，B 是随之而来的连带影响、配套调整或副作用。
n2.day10-change.grammar.2.logic.en: A Often a larger social, organizational or institutional change, B is associated with the associated effects, accompanying adjustments or side effects.

n2.day10-change.grammar.2.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋に伴って

n2.day10-change.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 「につれて」关注渐变的程度；「に伴って」更像“一个大变动一来，相关事情也得跟着变”。
n2.day10-change.grammar.2.contrast.en: につれて emphasizes gradual correlated change; に伴って describes related changes accompanying a major development.

n2.day10-change.grammar.2.translation.zh: 伴随着人口增加，交通问题也连带着严重起来。
n2.day10-change.grammar.2.translation.en: With the increase in the population, transportation problems have become even more acute.

n2.day10-change.grammar.3.logic.zh: A 与 B 同时发生或并行推进，也可以表示两个主体一起行动。用来说变化时语气较正式。
n2.day10-change.grammar.3.logic.en: A is also a combination or parallel move with B, which means that the two subjects act together.

n2.day10-change.grammar.3.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／い形容词／な形容词である／名词＋とともに

n2.day10-change.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 与前三项相比，它的核心更宽：不一定是 A 导致 B，也可以只强调两者同步发生。
n2.day10-change.grammar.3.contrast.en: Its core is broader than the first three: it may not necessarily be A leading to B, but it may also emphasize that the two occur simultaneously.

n2.day10-change.grammar.3.translation.zh: 随着时代变化，人们的工作方式也同时发生了变化。
n2.day10-change.grammar.3.translation.en: The way people work has changed along with the times.

n2.day10-change.question.0.explanation.zh: 适应日语的程度一点点变化，享受会话的程度也自然跟着变，用「につれて」。
n2.day10-change.question.0.explanation.en: To adapt to the Japanese language, the level of enjoyment naturally follows, using " につれて " .

n2.day10-change.question.1.explanation.zh: 随着登山进程，气温逐渐下降，是典型的两种程度性变化。
n2.day10-change.question.1.explanation.en: Temperatures are declining as a result of the mountain climb process, which is typical of two degrees of change.

n2.day10-change.question.2.explanation.zh: 孩子的成长与独立能力都是逐渐变化，「につれて」最直接。
n2.day10-change.question.2.explanation.en: The child’s ability to grow and become independent is gradually changing, and the most direct is につれて.

n2.day10-change.question.3.explanation.zh: 时代按方向推进，观念也依这一趋势逐步改变，书面语的「にしたがって」很自然。
n2.day10-change.question.3.explanation.en: The times have moved in the direction and attitudes have gradually changed along these lines, and it is natural that the written words "にしたがって " should be written.

n2.day10-change.question.4.explanation.zh: 计划从抽象到具体逐步推进，所需人数也随之明确，用「にしたがって」。
n2.day10-change.question.4.explanation.en: The number of people required for the planned step-by-step move, from abstract to concrete, is also specified by " にしたがって " .

n2.day10-change.question.5.explanation.zh: 按向北的路线向前推进，风逐渐变强；强调沿着进程变化用「にしたがって」。
n2.day10-change.question.5.explanation.en: Moving northwards, wind becomes stronger; emphasis is placed on " にしたがって " .

n2.day10-change.question.6.explanation.zh: 公司扩张是较大的组织变动，新制度是连带而来的配套需求。
n2.day10-change.question.6.explanation.en: Corporate expansion is a major organizational change, and the new system is associated with demand.

n2.day10-change.question.6.anchor.en: And along with it, it happens.

n2.day10-change.question.7.explanation.zh: 建新工厂带来周边道路的配套整备，是大变动及其连带影响。
n2.day10-change.question.7.explanation.en: The construction of the new plant will bring with it a complement to the surrounding road, which will be a major change and its associated impact.

n2.day10-change.question.7.anchor.en: And along with it, it happens.

n2.day10-change.question.8.explanation.zh: 在线教学普及带来相关服务，是一种社会变化所产生的连带结果。
n2.day10-change.question.8.explanation.en: Access to online teaching brings with it services and is a cascading result of social change.

n2.day10-change.question.8.anchor.en: And along with it, it happens.

n2.day10-change.question.9.explanation.zh: 这里不是变化因果，而是他和家人一起搬家，「とともに」还能表示共同行动。
n2.day10-change.question.9.explanation.en: This is not a cause or effect of change, but rather a move with his family. "とともに" also represents joint action.

n2.day10-change.question.10.explanation.zh: 她同时具有研究者和三个孩子的母亲两重身份，用「であるとともに」。
n2.day10-change.question.10.explanation.en: She also has a dual identity of researcher and mother of three children, using " であるとともに " .

n2.day10-change.question.11.explanation.zh: 这种药有两种并列功能：降热的同时还能缓解疼痛，用「とともに」。
n2.day10-change.question.11.explanation.en: This drug has two parallel functions: it reduces pain while reducing heat, using "とともに " .

n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.logic.zh: 对一件实现难度高、希望渺茫或未必由自己决定的事提出假设，常接愿望、选择或回应。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.logic.en: It is often the desire, choice or response to make assumptions about a matter that is difficult to achieve, has little hope or does not necessarily depend on itself.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.connection.zh: 动词可能形等＋ものなら（如戻れるものなら；难实现的假设）
n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.connection.en: Verb potential form + ものなら (e.g. 戻れるものなら): a difficult-to-realize condition.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 「戻れるものなら」常带“要是能做到”的愿望；「話そうものなら」用意向形，警告一旦做了将有严重结果。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.contrast.en: 戻れるものなら expresses a difficult wish: if only I could go back. 話そうものなら warns of a serious consequence if someone dares to tell. The former uses a potential form; the latter uses a volitional form.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.translation.zh: 要是真能去的话，我想试试环游世界。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.0.translation.en: I'd like to try the world if I can.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.anchor.zh: 要是敢 / 一旦……那可就……

n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.logic.zh: 假设某个危险、不得体或不希望发生的动作真的发生，后项就会出现严重结果。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.logic.en: Assuming that a dangerous, indecent or undesirable action actually occurs, the latter would have serious consequences.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 看到意向形「言おう／しよう」再加上警告性后果，就是这一项。它不是对美好愿望的假设。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.contrast.en: The volitional forms 言おう／しよう followed by a warning of bad consequences identify this pattern. It does not express a hopeful wish.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.translation.zh: 你要敢说这种话，那可就会被大家反对。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.1.translation.en: If you say that, it will be rejected.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.anchor.en: If you don't first, there's no way...

n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.logic.zh: A 是判断或实现 B 之前不可缺少的前置步骤。不先完成 A，B 就根本无从谈起。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.logic.en: A is an indispensable prelude to judgement or realization of B. There is no way to talk about it without completing A.B.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 后项通常是「分からない／できない／決められない」等否定或不能判断的表达。它比一般「ない限り」更突出“先做 A 才能谈 B”。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.contrast.en: The following clause usually expresses a negative or inability to judge, such as 分からない／できない／決められない. Compared with ない限り, this pattern stresses that A must happen before B can even be considered.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.translation.zh: 不先实际用一下，根本不知道好不好用。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.2.translation.en: I don't know if it's gonna work.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.logic.zh: A 不成立的整个范围内，B 都不会改变。中文常要倒过来说成“除非 A，否则 B”。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.logic.en: The whole range of "A" is not going to change. Chinese often says "B unless it's "B."

n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.connection.zh: 动词ない形／い形容词くない／な形容词でない／名词でない＋限り
n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.connection.en: Verb nai-form; i-adjective + くない; na-adjective/noun + でない; then 限り.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 「ないことには」是必须先做的步骤；「ない限り」是一个持续成立的必要条件，适用范围更广。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.contrast.en: ないことには describes a necessary first step; ない限り describes a continuing necessary condition and has a wider range of uses.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.translation.zh: 除非努力，否则就别指望进步。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.3.translation.en: Unless efforts were made, progress would not be expected.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.logic.zh: 说话人暂时把某个情况当真，然后谈自己会怎么想、怎么选或事情会怎么发展。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.logic.en: Those who speak take a situation seriously for the time being and then talk about what they think, how they choose or how things develop.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.connection.zh: 普通形＋としたら（名词／な形现在肯定保留だ：学生だとしたら・必要だとすれば）
n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.connection.en: Plain form + としたら. Keep だ for affirmative non-past nouns/na-adjectives: 学生だとしたら, 必要だとすれば.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 「としたら」更容易跟说话人的反应、选择相连；「とすれば」更像在纸上接受一个前提，再逻辑推导。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.contrast.en: " としたら " is more likely to be linked to the reactions and choices of those who speak; " とすれば " is more like accepting a premise on paper, re-routing.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.translation.zh: 假如真要在海外工作一年，你会选哪个国家？
n2.day11-condition.grammar.4.translation.en: What country would you choose if you were to work overseas for a year?

n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.logic.zh: 把 A 作为逻辑前提或已知条件，然后推算从这个前提能得出的结论 B。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.logic.en: Use A as a logical premise or known condition, and then extrapolate the conclusions that can be drawn from this premise.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.connection.zh: 普通形＋とすれば（名词／な形现在肯定保留だ：学生だとしたら・必要だとすれば）
n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.connection.en: Plain form + とすれば. Keep だ for affirmative non-past nouns/na-adjectives: 学生だとしたら, 必要だとすれば.

n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 两者很多时候都能通。需要拉开语感时，个人选择和感受偏「としたら」，根据前提计算人数、时间、结论时偏「とすれば」。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.contrast.en: Both often work. When you need to open your speech, the individual chooses and feels "としたら" and calculates the number, time, and conclusions according to premise "とすれば".

n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.translation.zh: 如果按每天看十页这个假设算，看完需要二十天。
n2.day11-condition.grammar.5.translation.en: If we look at the 10 pages a day, it takes 20 days to finish.

n2.day11-condition.question.0.explanatio.zh: 重来人生几乎不可能，这里是对难以实现的愿望提出假设，用「ものなら」。
n2.day11-condition.question.0.explanatio.en: It's almost impossible to start a new life. This is an assumption of a hard-to-be wish, using "ものなら " .

n2.day11-condition.question.1.explanatio.zh: 表达“如果真有机会再见”的希望，接可能形「会える」后用「ものなら」。
n2.day11-condition.question.1.explanatio.en: Attach ものなら to the potential 会える to express hope for an opportunity to meet again.

n2.day11-condition.question.2.explanatio.zh: 「弾こう」是意向形，后面又是邻居投诉的坏后果，整体用「弾こうものなら」。 补充：弾くとしたら也能假设弹琴将被投诉；弾こうものなら更强烈地警告后果。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「弾こうものなら」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day11-condition.question.2.explanatio.en: Target expression: 弾こうものなら. Intended meaning: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act. Compared alternatives: 弾くとしたら. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day11-condition.question.2.anchor.en: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act.

n2.day11-condition.question.3.explanatio.zh: 用意向形「話そう」假设对方真敢泄密，并给出严重后果，整体是「話そうものなら」。 补充：話すとすれば也能作假设；話そうものなら具有更强的威胁／警告意味。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「話そうものなら」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day11-condition.question.3.explanatio.en: Target expression: 話そうものなら. Intended meaning: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act. Compared alternatives: 話すとすれば. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day11-condition.question.3.anchor.en: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act.

n2.day11-condition.question.4.explanatio.zh: 不先看实物，就根本无法决定是否购买，看实物是前置步骤。
n2.day11-condition.question.4.explanatio.en: It is simply impossible to decide whether or not to purchase it without first looking at the material, which is a step forward.

n2.day11-condition.question.4.anchor.en: If you don't first, there's no way...

n2.day11-condition.question.5.explanatio.zh: 直接询问是了解真正理由之前必须完成的步骤，后项也是「分からない」。
n2.day11-condition.question.5.explanatio.en: Asking directly is the step required before the true reason can be understood. The following clause uses 分からない.

n2.day11-condition.question.5.anchor.en: If you don't first, there's no way...

n2.day11-condition.question.6.explanatio.zh: 除非本人道歉，否则“不打算原谅”这一判断一直成立，用「ない限り」。
n2.day11-condition.question.6.explanatio.en: Unless the person apologizes, the refusal to forgive remains in force. Use ない限り.

n2.day11-condition.question.7.explanatio.zh: 在法律不改变的范围内，现行制度就会继续，表持续条件用「ない限り」。
n2.day11-condition.question.7.explanatio.en: The current system continues as long as the law does not change. Use ない限り for this continuing condition.

n2.day11-condition.question.8.explanatio.zh: 对方在这个假设下会选择做什么，是个人反应型的「としたら」。
n2.day11-condition.question.8.explanatio.en: The other party chooses what to do under this scenario, the individual reaction type " としたら " .

n2.day11-condition.question.9.explanatio.zh: 接受“他说的是真的”这个假设后，询问对方会怎么做，偏个人选择。
n2.day11-condition.question.9.explanatio.en: After accepting the assumption that “what he says is true”, ask each other what to do and prefer to choose.

n2.day11-condition.question.10.explanati.zh: 把每人五千日元作为计算前提，用「とすれば」。五千円×百人＝五十万円。
n2.day11-condition.question.10.explanati.en: Five thousand yen per person is used as a basis for calculating it, using "とすれば. "

n2.day11-condition.question.11.explanati.zh: 以当前速度继续作为前提，逻辑推算剩余时间，用「とすれば」。
n2.day11-condition.question.11.explanati.en: Continues at the current rate, logically extrapolating the remaining time using " とすれば " .

n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.logic.zh: 先把预想中的 A 彻底否定，再推到距离 A 更远、甚至方向相反的 B。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.logic.en: First, a complete rejection of the envisaged A, then a further distance from A to B, even in the opposite direction.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 「どころか」后面要继续说真实情况 B；「どころではない」则表示被现实压得根本顾不上 A。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.contrast.en: After "どころか" let's go on to the real situation B; "どころではない" means that the reality is not really about A.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.translation.zh: 别说日语变好了，反而比以前更不会说了。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.0.translation.en: Don't say Japanese is better than ever.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.logic.zh: 因为有更紧急、严重或繁忙的现实，说话人根本没有余裕去做 A。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.logic.en: Because of the more urgent, serious or busy reality, there is nothing much more to talk about.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋どころではない（口语：どころじゃない）
n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.connection.en: verb dictionary form／noun＋どころではない（conversational：どころじゃない）

n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 它不是普通的“不做”，而是“现在的情况下根本顾不上”。中文用“哪还……”最容易抓住。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.contrast.en: It is not an ordinary “no”, but rather a “neither in the present circumstances at all.” The word “where” in Chinese is the easiest to grasp.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.1.translation.zh: 忙成这样，哪还有心思旅游。

n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.logic.zh: 说话人对 A 的抵触很强，宁愿选择另一个也许同样不理想、但至少更能接受的 B。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.logic.en: Talkers have a strong resistance to A and prefer another B, which may be equally undesirable but at least more acceptable.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.connection.zh: 动词辞书形＋くらいなら

n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 后项常与「ほうがいい／ましだ」搭配。它不是冷静比较两个方案，而是有明显的“都要 A 了，那我宁愿 B”。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.contrast.en: The latter often goes hand in hand with "ほうがいい / ましだ " . It's not a cool comparison between the two options, it's a clear "all A now, then I'd rather B."

n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.translation.zh: 与其继续做讨厌的工作，还不如辞掉。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.2.translation.en: Instead of continuing with the hateful work, it would be better to resign.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.logic.zh: 用 A 当作尺子，说明动作、状态或感受已经达到那么高的程度。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.logic.en: Use A as a ruler to indicate how high the movement, state or feeling has been.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 「ほど」单独表程度；「ば～ほど」则表示两个程度联动，中文是“越……越……”。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.contrast.en: ほど expresses degree; ば～ほど links two degrees, meaning the more …, the more ….

n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.translation.zh: 紧张到连声音都发不出来的程度。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.3.translation.en: I'm so nervous that I can't even make a sound.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.logic.zh: A 的程度上升，B 也依次上升或变化。日语常把同一动词或形容词重复两次。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.logic.en: A scale rises and B rises or changes in turn. Japanese often repeats the same verb or impactive.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.connection.zh: Vば形＋V辞书形＋ほど；い形去い＋ければ＋原形＋ほど；な形词干＋なら＋な形词干＋なほど
n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.connection.en: Verb ba-form + dictionary form + ほど; i-adjective without い + ければ + dictionary form + ほど; na-adjective stem + なら + stem + なほど.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 読めば読むほど／安ければ安いほど／静かなら静かなほど。な形也可说「静かであればあるほど」。不要接成「静かならであるほど」。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.contrast.en: Examples: 読めば読むほど／安ければ安いほど／静かなら静かなほど. A na-adjective can also take 静かであればあるほど. Do not form 静かならであるほど.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.4.translation.en: It's more interesting to learn Japanese.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.logic.zh: 为了后项的目标，甚至不惜采取平常难以接受、代价很高或过度的 A。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.logic.en: For the purposes of the latter objective, even resort to commonly unacceptable, costly or excessive A.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 「てまで」把极端行为放在目标前；「までして」常把一种手段或付出拎出来评价“都做到这份上了”。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.contrast.en: "てまで" places extreme behaviour ahead of the target; "までして" often gives a means or gives an evaluation "that's all."

n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.translation.zh: 我不想为了买那辆车，甚至不惜去借钱。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.5.translation.en: I don't even want to borrow money to buy that car.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.logic.zh: 说话人把一个极端手段、牺牲或付出单独拎出，表示对“竟然都做到这份上”的惊讶、批评或感叹。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.logic.en: Those who speak take an extreme measure, sacrifice or single out, express surprise, criticism or sigh at “doing it all the time”.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.contrast.zh: 两者都表超常程度。「てまで」把极端动作放在目标前；「までして」更容易用名词突出手段本身，如「借金までして」。
n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.contrast.en: Both express an exceptional degree. てまで places an extreme action before the goal; までして often highlights the means itself through a noun, as in 借金までして.

n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.translation.zh: 真有必要甚至做到借钱这份上，去买那辆车吗？
n2.day12-degree.grammar.6.translation.en: It's really necessary to even borrow the money for that car?

n2.day12-degree.question.0.explanation.zh: 先否定“旅行很开心”，再说实际上雨不停、连门都出不了，用「どころか」。
n2.day12-degree.question.0.explanation.en: You can't even get out of the door without saying, "Travel is fun." どころか 」。

n2.day12-degree.question.1.explanation.zh: 不只日语，还会英语和中文，「どころか」也能从 A 推进到程度更高的 B。
n2.day12-degree.question.1.explanation.en: Not only Japanese, but also English and Chinese, so that "どころか" can move from A to a higher B.

n2.day12-degree.question.2.explanation.zh: 考试准备还没完成，根本没有余裕看电影，用「映画どころではない」。
n2.day12-degree.question.2.explanation.en: Exam preparation is unfinished, leaving no time for a movie. Use 映画どころではない.

n2.day12-degree.question.3.explanation.zh: 公司都快破产了，当然根本顾不上奖金，「ボーナスどころではない」很自然。
n2.day12-degree.question.3.explanation.en: The company is close to bankruptcy, so bonuses are out of the question. ボーナスどころではない is natural.

n2.day12-degree.question.4.explanation.zh: 说话人对一边被抱怨一边工作很抵触，宁愿辞职，用「くらいなら」。
n2.day12-degree.question.4.explanation.en: The talker who complains about work on one side is in conflict with the other and prefers to resign, using the term "くらいなら " .

n2.day12-degree.question.5.explanation.zh: 与其和不喜欢的人结婚，宁愿独处，是典型的「くらいなら～ほうがいい」。
n2.day12-degree.question.5.explanation.en: Preferring to be alone rather than marry someone one dislikes is a typical use of くらいなら～ほうがいい.

n2.day12-degree.question.6.explanation.zh: 疲惫程度高到无法站立，用「ほど」把前面的状态当作程度尺子。
n2.day12-degree.question.6.explanation.en: The level of fatigue is so high that it cannot stand, using " ほど " as a scale rule.

n2.day12-degree.question.7.explanation.zh: 热闹程度高到听不见说话声，用「ほど」。
n2.day12-degree.question.7.explanation.en: High enough to be deaf to speak with "ほど".

n2.day12-degree.question.8.explanation.zh: 整句是「考えれば考えるほど」，表示越想越不明白。
n2.day12-degree.question.8.explanation.en: 考えれば考えるほど means that the more one thinks, the less one understands.

n2.day12-degree.question.9.explanation.zh: 整句是「少なければ少ないほど」，表示行李越少，移动越轻松。
n2.day12-degree.question.9.explanation.en: 少なければ少ないほど means that the less luggage there is, the easier it is to move around.

n2.day12-degree.question.10.explanation.zh: 为了赚钱甚至不惜损害健康，说话人认为这种代价没有必要，用「てまで」。
n2.day12-degree.question.10.explanation.en: In order to earn money and even to hurt health, the talker did not think it was necessary to use " てまで " .

n2.day12-degree.question.11.explanation.zh: 把“借钱”这个极端手段单独拎出，说明说话人无法理解为买豪车做到这份上。
n2.day12-degree.question.11.explanation.en: The extreme means of “lending money” alone means that a person who speaks cannot be understood as buying a luxury car to do so.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.logic.zh: 某种不太理想的行为、状态或事情反复发生，像是一种容易掉进去的倾向。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.logic.en: Some less desirable behaviour, state or event recurs as if it were a tendency to fall easily.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.connection.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋がち

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 「がち」说反复出现的倾向，通常偏负面；「気味」只说当下略微有那种状态，程度较轻。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.contrast.en: がち describes a recurring tendency, usually undesirable. 気味 describes a slight current condition.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.translation.zh: 一忙起来，就老是容易不吃早饭。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.0.translation.en: It's always easy not to eat breakfast.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.logic.zh: 说话人感觉身体、情绪或状态开始略微偏向某个方向，还没有到很严重的程度。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.logic.en: The person who speaks feels that the body, mood or state is starting to slightly tend to a certain direction, not to a significant extent.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.connection.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋気味

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 「疲れ気味」是“有点累”；「疲れがち」是“经常容易累”。前者看当下程度，后者看反复倾向。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.contrast.en: 「疲れ気味」means a little tired now; 「疲れがち」means tending to get tired often. One describes degree; the other describes a recurring tendency.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.1.translation.en: I've been feeling a little tired lately.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.anchor.zh: 动不动就…… / 很有……那味
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.anchor.en: If you don't move, it's very...

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.logic.zh: 可以表示某个行为很容易发生，也可以表示人或事物显得具有某种特质、颜色或印象。语气较口语。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.logic.en: You can say that an act is easy to perform, or that a person or thing appears to have a quality, colour, or impression.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.connection.zh: 部分动词ます形去ます／名词／部分形容词词干＋っぽい（搭配需单独记）
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.connection.en: Selected verb masu-stems, nouns or adjective stems + っぽい. Learn each combination separately.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 忘れっぽい・子供っぽい・水っぽい都是常用搭配，不能把任意动词都机械加っぽい。がち说容易反复发生，気味说略有某状态；同一句中有时都能用，但观察角度不同。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.contrast.en: 忘れっぽい・子供っぽい・水っぽい are established combinations; do not mechanically add っぽい to every verb. がち emphasizes recurrence, while 気味 describes a slight condition. They may sometimes fit the same sentence but present different perspectives.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.translation.zh: 他特别爱忘事，所以什么都会记下来。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.2.translation.en: He's very fond of forgetting things, so everything will be written down.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.anchor.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.anchor.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.logic.zh: 变化沿着一个方向不断推进，没有出现停止或反转的迹象。可用于好坏变化，但负面很常见。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.logic.en: Change progresses in one direction, with no signs of cessation or reversal. It can be used for good and bad change, but negatives are common.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.connection.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋一方だ

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 「一方だ」相对中性，关注单向趋势；「ばかりだ」常带“只会继续这样”的无奈或担忧。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.contrast.en: 一方だ is relatively neutral and focuses on a one-way trend. ばかりだ often adds resignation or concern that the trend will continue.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.translation.zh: 这座城市的人口越来越少，一路都在减少。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.3.translation.en: The population of this city is shrinking and has been decreasing all along.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.logic.zh: 事情只沿着某个、往往不理想的方向继续发展，说话人对这个趋势带有无奈或忧虑。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.logic.en: Things continue to evolve only in a certain, often undesired, direction, and speakers have no choice or concern about this trend.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.connection.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋ばかりだ
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.connection.en: change-denoting verb dictionary form＋ばかりだ

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 别和「动词た形＋ばかりだ」的“刚刚……”混淆。这里接辞书形，表示趋势只会继续。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.contrast.en: Do not confuse "just..." with "verb た + ばかりだ. Here, add the desired form, indicating that the trend will only continue.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.translation.zh: 物价只会越来越高，生活一点也没轻松。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.4.translation.en: Prices will only get higher and life will not be easy.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.logic.zh: 表示动作后状态持续，或某动作一直持续。放置不管的负面意味很常见，但不是必有。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.logic.en: indicates that the action continues, or that the action persists. The negative implication is common, but not necessarily.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.connection.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋っぱなし

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 電気をつけっぱなし＝灯开着没关；立ちっぱなし＝一直站着。后者只是说明持续与负担，不一定有人忘了处理。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.contrast.en: 電気をつけっぱなし means leaving the lights on; 立ちっぱなし means standing continuously. The latter describes duration and strain, without necessarily implying neglect.

n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.translation.zh: 灯一直开着没关，我就睡着了。
n2.day13-tendency.grammar.5.translation.en: The lights were on and I fell asleep.

n2.day13-tendency.question.0.explanation.zh: 最近反复出现不出门、闷在家里的倾向，「家にこもりがち」表示经常容易这样。 补充：こもり気味描述最近略有闭门不出的状态；こもりっぱなし指持续不出门；こもりがち强调经常如此。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「がち」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day13-tendency.question.0.explanation.en: Target expression: がち. Intended meaning: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency. Compared alternatives: 気味 / っぱなし. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day13-tendency.question.0.anchor.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

n2.day13-tendency.question.1.explanation.zh: 「なりがち」表示经常容易变得不规律；「なり気味」也可说明近来稍有这种倾向。前者强调反复，后者强调程度；本题提示要求反复发生的倾向。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「がち」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day13-tendency.question.1.explanation.en: Target expression: がち. Intended meaning: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency. Compared alternatives: 気味. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day13-tendency.question.1.anchor.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

n2.day13-tendency.question.2.explanation.zh: 说的是当下身体有一点疲惫，程度较轻，用「疲れ気味」。 补充：疲れがち也能说最近经常容易疲劳；疲れ気味则着重当下略有疲惫。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「気味」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day13-tendency.question.2.explanation.en: Target expression: 気味. Intended meaning: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences. Compared alternatives: がち. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day13-tendency.question.2.anchor.en: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences.

n2.day13-tendency.question.3.explanation.zh: 風邪気味是“有点感冒”的常用搭配，気味读ぎみ，表示略有某状态。不能只凭中文“有点发烧”生造「熱気味」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.3.explanation.en: 風邪気味 is an established expression meaning a slight cold. 気味 is read ぎみ and describes a slight condition. Do not invent 熱気味 simply from the idea of having a slight fever.

n2.day13-tendency.question.4.explanation.zh: 「忘れっぽい」是很爱忘事的口语表达，接动词ます形词干。
n2.day13-tendency.question.4.explanation.en: 忘れっぽい is a conversational expression for tending to forget. Attach っぽい to the verb's masu-stem.

n2.day13-tendency.question.5.explanation.zh: 说成年人的说话方式很孩子气，名词「子供」后接「っぽい」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.5.explanation.en: Attach っぽい to the noun 子供 to describe an adult's childish way of speaking.

n2.day13-tendency.question.6.explanation.zh: 失业率沿上升方向持续变化，中性描述单向趋势用「一方だ」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.6.explanation.en: The unemployment rate continues to rise. Use 一方だ for a neutral description of a one-way trend.

n2.day13-tendency.question.6.anchor.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
n2.day13-tendency.question.6.anchor.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

n2.day13-tendency.question.7.explanation.zh: 持续练习让演奏水平不断提高，说好变化也可用相对中性的「一方だ」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.7.explanation.en: Continued practice steadily improves performance. The relatively neutral 一方だ can also describe positive change.

n2.day13-tendency.question.7.anchor.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
n2.day13-tendency.question.7.anchor.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

n2.day13-tendency.question.8.explanation.zh: 如果不采取对策，情况只会继续恶化，带有无奈和担忧的「ばかりだ」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.8.explanation.en: If no response is taken, the situation will only continue to deteriorate and the " ばかりだ " , which has a sense of hopelessness and concern.

n2.day13-tendency.question.9.explanation.zh: 不修缮的话建筑只会越来越旧，说话人对这个不良趋势带有忧虑。
n2.day13-tendency.question.9.explanation.en: The building will only grow old without renovation, and the speaker is concerned about this negative trend.

n2.day13-tendency.question.10.explanatio.zh: 门打开后本该关上，却一直开着就出门了，用「開けっぱなし」。
n2.day13-tendency.question.10.explanatio.en: The door should have been closed, but was left open when the person went out. Use 開けっぱなし.

n2.day13-tendency.question.11.explanatio.zh: 申请文件放在桌上后一直没处理，「置きっぱなし」带有放着不管的语气。
n2.day13-tendency.question.11.explanatio.en: The application papers were left on the desk without being dealt with. 置きっぱなし implies leaving them unattended.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.logic.zh: 根据既有信息、常识、计划或时间表进行推理，得出某个结论按道理应该成立。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.logic.en: A conclusion based on a reasoning based on information, common sense, plans or timetables already in place should be justified.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.connection.zh: 普通形＋はずだ（な形容词＋な；名词＋の）

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 「はずだ」的“应该”是根据推理；「べきだ」的“应该”是道德、规则或价值判断。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.contrast.en: The term "はずだ" is based on reasoning; the word "べきだ" is a moral, rule or value judgement.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.translation.zh: 他十点就出发了，按理说现在应该已经到了。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.0.translation.en: He's leaving at 10:00, and it's supposed to be here by now.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.logic.zh: 说话人从责任、道德、规则或正确做法的角度，判断某人应当或不应当采取某个行动。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.logic.en: Those who speak judge a person from the point of view of responsibility, morality, rules or correct practices that a person should or should not take a certain action.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.connection.zh: 动词辞书形＋べきだ（する→すべきだ／するべきだ）
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.connection.en: verb dictionary form＋べきだ（する→すべきだ／するべきだ）

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 它比「ことだ」更强，容易像在讲原则或责任。对上级或陌生人直接使用可能显得强硬。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.contrast.en: It's stronger than "ことだ" and easier to talk about principles or responsibilities. Direct use of superiors or strangers may seem tough.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.translation.zh: 答应别人的事照理就该做到。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.1.translation.en: Promise someone else to do what they have to do.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.logic.zh: 面对具体问题，给对方一条实用的建议、忠告或解决办法。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.logic.en: In the face of specific problems, a practical advice, advice or solution is given to each other.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ことだ

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 这是 Day 5 的复习点。「ことだ」是“最好这么做”的建议；「べきだ」是“照理就应当这么做”的规范判断。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.contrast.en: This is a refresher point for Day 5. "ことだ" is the "best way to do this" proposal; "べきだ" is the normative judgement of "it is right to do so".

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.translation.zh: 想尽快恢复的话，最好好好休息。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.2.translation.en: If you want to recover as soon as possible, you'd better get some rest.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.logic.zh: 根据现有线索或说话人的确信，强烈判断某事就是如此，基本不怀疑。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.logic.en: Based on existing leads or the conviction of those who speak, there is little doubt that something is so strongly judged.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.connection.zh: 普通形／名词＋に違いない（な形容词／名词通常不加だ）
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.connection.en: plain form／noun＋に違いない（na-adjective／nounusually without だ）

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.contrast.zh: に違いない通常基于迹象很有把握地判断；に決まっている更容易带强烈主观确信；はずだ重按已知信息推理。三者有交叉，不能把某一种线索机械绑定成唯一答案。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.contrast.en: に違いない usually expresses a confident inference from evidence. に決まっている more often expresses strong subjective conviction. はずだ reasons from known information. Their uses overlap; a single clue does not always determine a unique answer.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.3.translation.en: The light's on. Someone's got to be inside.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.anchor.zh: 肯定就是…… / 这还用说

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.logic.zh: 说话人凭自己的信念、经验或常识做出斩钉截铁的断定，常带感情色彩。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.logic.en: Those who speak make firm determinations based on their own convictions, experience or common sense are often emotional.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.connection.zh: 普通形／名词＋に決まっている（な形容词／名词通常不加だ）
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.connection.en: plain form／noun＋に決まっている（na-adjective／nounusually without だ）

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 它往往不像「はずだ」那样展示清晰推理链，而是直接说“肯定是这样”。语气很强，不适合需要谨慎的场合。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.contrast.en: It often does not show a clear line of reasoning like "はずだ", but simply says, "It sure is." It's a strong tone that doesn't fit in situations where caution is needed.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.translation.zh: 那种天上掉馅饼的好事肯定是假的，这还用说。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.4.translation.en: The good thing about falling pies out of the sky is a lie, of course.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.logic.zh: 客观、正式地提示某个不良事件发生的可能性，常用于天气、医疗、产品警示、新闻或官方说明。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.logic.en: Objective and formal indications of the possibility of an undesirable event are often used in weather, medical treatment, product alerts, news or official statements.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.connection.zh: 动词辞书形／名词の＋おそれがある
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.connection.en: verb dictionary form／nounの＋おそれがある

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 「おそれがある」是公式、客观的风险提示；「かねない」是说话人根据当前趋势警告“搞不好真会变成那样”。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.contrast.en: "おそれがある" is a formula, an objective risk reminder; "かねない" is a talker warning, based on current trends, that "it may turn out to be so."

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.translation.zh: 今晚恐怕有降下大雪的风险。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.5.translation.en: I'm afraid there's a risk of snowfall tonight.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.logic.zh: 从现在的做法或趋势看，一个不好的结果完全有可能发生。说话人常用它警告对方或表达担忧。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.logic.en: In the current practice or trend, a bad result is entirely possible. Talkers often warn each other or express their concerns.

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.connection.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋かねない

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.contrast.zh: 它形式上有「ない」，意思却是“有可能”。后项基本是坏结果，不用来说「かねないから合格する」这种好事。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.contrast.en: It takes the form of "ない" which means "possibly." The latter is basically a bad result, not to mention a good thing like "かねないから合格する. "

n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.translation.zh: 这样下去，搞不好会酿成大事故。
n2.day14-judgment.grammar.6.translation.en: This could lead to a big accident.

n2.day14-judgment.question.0.explanation.zh: 根据在日本工作五年这条信息，推理他按理会说日语，用「はずだ」。
n2.day14-judgment.question.0.explanation.en: On the basis of the information that he worked in Japan for five years, it was reasoned that he spoke Japanese and used " はずだ " .

n2.day14-judgment.question.1.explanation.zh: 根据地图上的时间做出合理推测，不是说对方有义务到达。 补充：に決まっている可表达更强的主观确信；はずだ更贴合根据地图计算路程的推理。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「はずだ」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.1.explanation.en: Target expression: はずだ. Intended meaning: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence. Compared alternatives: に決まっている. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.1.anchor.en: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence.

n2.day14-judgment.question.2.explanation.zh: 按照责任和规则，借来的东西就应该如期归还，用「べきだ」。 补充：返すことだ也能直接给建议；返すべきだ更强调归还借物的规范与责任。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「べきだ」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.2.explanation.en: Target expression: べきだ. Intended meaning: A duty or norm, rather than personal advice. Compared alternatives: ことだ. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.2.anchor.en: A duty or norm, rather than personal advice.

n2.day14-judgment.question.3.explanation.zh: 说话人从正确做法的角度判断不应独断，用「べきではない」。 补充：一人で決めることではない也成立，表示这不是你该独自决定的事；べきではない则直接劝阻这种行为。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「べき」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.3.explanation.en: Target expression: べき. Intended meaning: An admonition about the proper course of action. Compared alternatives: こと. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.3.anchor.en: An admonition about the proper course of action.

n2.day14-judgment.question.4.explanation.zh: 面对感冒如何早点好的具体问题，给出“最好早睡”的建议，用「ことだ」。 补充：寝るべきだ也是建议，但更强硬；具体养病建议用ことだ通常更合适。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「ことだ」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.4.explanation.en: Target expression: ことだ. Intended meaning: Practical advice for this particular problem, without a strong moral obligation. Compared alternatives: べきだ. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.4.anchor.en: Practical advice for this particular problem, without a strong moral obligation.

n2.day14-judgment.question.5.explanation.zh: 「きっと」结合鞋子这个线索，表达很有把握的推断，选に違いない。べきだ表达规范、ことだ表达建议，均不等于这里的行踪推断。
n2.day14-judgment.question.5.explanation.en: きっと and the clue provided by the shoes indicate a confident inference, so use に違いない. べきだ expresses an obligation and ことだ gives advice; neither expresses this inference about someone's whereabouts.

n2.day14-judgment.question.6.explanation.zh: 说话人以强烈、口语的方式断定便宜的名牌货肯定是假的，名词直接接「に決まっている」。 补充：のはずだ表达推断；のおそれがある只说有假货风险；に決まっている是强烈断定，不能把价格低当成已经证实假货。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「に決まっている」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.6.explanation.en: Target expression: に決まっている. Intended meaning: The speaker's emphatic subjective certainty, rather than a mere possibility. Compared alternatives: のはずだ / のおそれがある. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.6.anchor.en: The speaker's emphatic subjective certainty, rather than a mere possibility.

n2.day14-judgment.question.7.explanation.zh: “他”以很强的主观确信说自己的队伍肯定会赢，用「に決まっている」。
n2.day14-judgment.question.7.explanation.en: He is strongly convinced that his team will win. Use に決まっている.

n2.day14-judgment.question.8.explanation.zh: 这是对道路结冰的正式风险提示，像天气或交通公告，用「おそれがある」。 补充：に決まっている是强烈断定会结冰；おそれがある仅说明风险，天气提醒中更合适。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「おそれがある」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day14-judgment.question.8.explanation.en: Target expression: おそれがある. Intended meaning: A formal warning of a possible risk, without claiming certainty. Compared alternatives: に決まっている. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day14-judgment.question.8.anchor.en: A formal warning of a possible risk, without claiming certainty.

n2.day14-judgment.question.9.explanation.zh: 产品警示中客观说明可能起火，名词「発火」后用「のおそれがある」。
n2.day14-judgment.question.9.explanation.en: A product warning objectively states a risk of fire. Attach のおそれがある to the noun 発火.

n2.day14-judgment.question.10.explanatio.zh: 如果继续隐瞒，搞不好会让整个公司失去信誉，用动词ます形词干「失い」接「かねない」。
n2.day14-judgment.question.10.explanatio.en: Continued concealment might cost the whole company its credibility. Attach かねない to the masu-stem 失い.

n2.day14-judgment.question.11.explanatio.zh: 警告鲁莽驾驶可能酿成重大事故，「起こし」后接「かねない」。
n2.day14-judgment.question.11.explanatio.en: Reckless driving may cause a serious accident. Attach かねない to 起こし.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.logic.zh: 前项的差别、条件或选项不会影响后项，所有情况都得到同样结果。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.logic.en: The differences, conditions or options in the former would not affect the latter and all cases would be subject to the same result.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.connection.zh: 名词／相对词组／动词辞书形・ない形＋にかかわらず
n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.connection.en: noun／contrasting expressions／verb dictionary form・nai-form＋にかかわらず

n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 别和 Day 8 的「にもかかわらず」混淆。有「も」的是“尽管 A 居然 B”；没有「も」的是“不管 A，B 都一样”。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.contrast.en: And don't confuse with Day 8 'にもかかわらず '. "も" is "Although A does B," and "も" is "A, B or A."

n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.translation.zh: 不管年龄多大，任何人都可以报名。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.0.translation.en: No matter how old, anyone can register.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.logic.zh: 正式地宣告某个分类标准不作限制，所有符合其他条件的人或情况一概适用后项。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.logic.en: Formally declare that a classification criterion is not restrictive and that the latter paragraph applies to all persons or situations that meet other conditions.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 与「にかかわらず」意思接近，但「を問わず」更书面、更像招聘、活动和公告，常接「年齢・性別・国籍・経験の有無」。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.contrast.en: Similar to にかかわらず, but を問わず is more formal and common in recruitment, events and announcements. It often follows 年齢・性別・国籍・経験の有無.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.translation.zh: 不论有无经验，一概可以报名。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.1.translation.en: Registration will be available, with or without experience.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.anchor.en: I'm not going to say anything.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.logic.zh: 暂时不评价 A 或不把 A 当作当前重点，转而强调更值得关注的 B。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.logic.en: A is not evaluated for the time being, or A is not considered a current focus, instead emphasizing B, which is of greater concern.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.connection.zh: 名词／普通形の＋はともかく

n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 「はともかく」多在比较评价中说“A 姑且不论，B 至少如何”；「はさておき」更像主持人主动把话题 A 放到一边，接着谈 B。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.contrast.en: More often than not, "はともかく" says in a comparative evaluation that "A leaves no matter what, B at least" and "はさておき" is more like the moderator taking the initiative to put topic A aside and then go on to B.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.translation.zh: 价格先不说，质量确实很好。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.2.translation.en: Prices are not said, and quality is indeed good.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.logic.zh: 有意识地把当前话题 A 暂时搁置，为接下来更重要或更正式的话题 B 腾出位置。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.logic.en: Deliberately put the current topic A on hold, leaving room for the next more important or formal topic B.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.connection.zh: 名词／普通形の＋はさておき

n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 这个表达有很清晰的话题操作感，常见于「冗談はさておき、本題に……」。它不一定要比较 A 和 B 哪个更好。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.contrast.en: This expression explicitly shifts the topic, as in 冗談はさておき、本題に……. It need not compare which of A and B is better.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.3.translation.zh: 玩笑先放一边，我们进入正题吧。

n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.logic.zh: 把对方可能看得过重的人、事、数量或判断压回它真实的有限范围：它没有超出 A。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.logic.en: (a) To crush the person, matter, number or judgement of the other person who may be over-visited to the limited extent that it is true: it does not exceed A.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.connection.zh: 名词／普通形＋にすぎない

n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 它的方向是弱化：“别把它想得太重，不过就是 A”。「にほかならない」则是强化和聚焦：“本质上正是 A”。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.contrast.en: It's in the direction of weakness: "Don't think too much about it, but it's A." "にほかならない" is reinforced and focused on: "It's essentially A."

n2.day15-scope.grammar.4.translation.zh: 这不过就是我个人的看法。

n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.logic.zh: 排除其他表面解释，把事物的真正原因、核心或本质精确锁定为 A。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.logic.en: Excluding other surface interpretations, the true cause, core or essence of the matter is precisely identified as A.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.connection.zh: 名词＋にほかならない；原因句常用「～のは、～からにほかならない」
n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.connection.en: Noun + にほかならない. A reason often uses ～のは、～からにほかならない.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.contrast.zh: にすぎない限制价值／范围：“不过是”；にほかならない强调本质／原因：“正是”。同一事实可用两者表达不同评价，需根据说话意图判断。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.contrast.en: にすぎない Limitation of value/range: “but”; にほかならない emphasizes nature/cause: “It is. The same fact can be used to express different evaluations, which are judged by the intent to speak.

n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.translation.zh: 成功的原因，说白了正是每天的努力。
n2.day15-scope.grammar.5.translation.en: The reason for success is the day-to-day effort.

n2.day15-scope.question.0.explanation.zh: 有没有经验不影响起点，所有人都从同一基础课开始。前面是完整问句形式，用「にかかわらず」。 补充：はともかく是暂时不讨论经验；にかかわらず明确表示不把经验作为分班条件。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「にかかわらず」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.0.explanation.en: Target expression: にかかわらず. Intended meaning: A condition that makes no difference to eligibility. Compared alternatives: はともかく. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.0.anchor.en: A condition that makes no difference to eligibility.

n2.day15-scope.question.1.explanation.zh: 下雨还是不下雨都不影响比赛举行，相对条件后用「にかかわらず」。 补充：はさておき可先搁置天气话题再说明比赛安排；にかかわらず明确表示天气不影响决定。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「にかかわらず」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.1.explanation.en: Target expression: にかかわらず. Intended meaning: A condition that makes no difference to the decision. Compared alternatives: はさておき. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.1.anchor.en: A condition that makes no difference to the decision.

n2.day15-scope.question.2.explanation.zh: 比赛规则正式声明不限国籍，名词「国籍」后用公告式的「を問わず」。 补充：はともかく可暂不讨论国籍；を問わず直接说明没有国籍限制。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「を問わず」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.2.explanation.en: Target expression: を問わず. Intended meaning: A formal statement that nationality is not a restriction. Compared alternatives: はともかく. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.2.anchor.en: A formal statement that nationality is not a restriction.

n2.day15-scope.question.3.explanation.zh: 招聘信息中正式表示不论年龄和性别，「を問わず」最符合公告语气。 补充：はさておき可先放下年龄性别的话题；を問わず更明确是招聘条件不限制这些因素。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「を問わず」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.3.explanation.en: Target expression: を問わず. Intended meaning: A formal statement that age and gender are not restrictions. Compared alternatives: はさておき. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.3.anchor.en: A formal statement that age and gender are not restrictions.

n2.day15-scope.question.4.explanation.zh: 设计好不好暂且不评价，转而强调电脑的性能好。题干已有「は」，补「ともかく」。
n2.day15-scope.question.4.explanation.en: Designs are not yet evaluated, instead they emphasize the performance of computers. The subject has been "は" and is supplemented by "ともかく. "

n2.day15-scope.question.4.anchor.en: I'm not going to say anything.

n2.day15-scope.question.5.explanation.zh: 方法正不正确先不说，至少结果已经出现。题干已有「は」，补「ともかく」。
n2.day15-scope.question.5.explanation.en: The method is not correct, at least the results have already appeared. The subject has been "は" and added "ともかく " .

n2.day15-scope.question.5.anchor.en: I'm not going to say anything.

n2.day15-scope.question.6.explanation.zh: 主动把费用话题暂时搁置，把讨论转到能否实现上，用「はさておき」。
n2.day15-scope.question.6.explanation.en: Take the initiative to put the issue of costs on hold and move the discussion to whether it is possible to do so, using "はさておき " .

n2.day15-scope.question.7.explanation.zh: 把开场铺垫暂时放到一边，要求直接说结论，是主动转换话题的「はさておき」。
n2.day15-scope.question.7.explanation.en: Putting the opening mat aside for the time being and asking for a direct conclusion is " はさておき " , which changes the subject.

n2.day15-scope.question.8.explanation.zh: 「伝えたにすぎない」把行为限定为转达。にほかならない通常接名词／名词化表达，如「伝えただけということにほかならない」，不能用无名词化的动词句机械替换。
n2.day15-scope.question.8.explanation.en: 伝えたにすぎない limits the action to passing on a message. にほかならない normally follows a noun or nominalized expression, such as 伝えただけということにほかならない. Do not mechanically replace it after a non-nominalized verb clause.

n2.day15-scope.question.9.explanation.zh: 将发言限定为个人意见，不要当成组织立场，是弱化的「にすぎない」。 补充：にほかならない强调“本质就是个人意见”；にすぎない弱化意见的权威与代表性。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「にすぎない」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.9.explanation.en: Target expression: にすぎない. Intended meaning: Only a personal opinion, downplaying its authority. Compared alternatives: にほかならない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.9.anchor.en: Only a personal opinion, downplaying its authority.

n2.day15-scope.question.10.explanation.zh: 「～のは、～からにほかならない」强调成功的真正原因。这里需要完整的原因形式，不能把「のは」与一个孤立的名词原因机械拼起来。
n2.day15-scope.question.10.explanation.en: In ～のは、～からにほかならない, the clause before から states the real reason. A complete reason clause is needed; an isolated noun cannot simply be inserted into that position.

n2.day15-scope.question.11.explanation.zh: 强调失败的本质正是准备不足造成的结果，用「にほかならない」。 补充：にすぎない也可表明只是准备不足的结果、无需过度解读；にほかならない则强调确定其本质。 本题按题面给定的意思和语气计分，只接受「にほかならない」。上述其他可成立的表达用于比较，不属于本题的目标答案。
n2.day15-scope.question.11.explanation.en: Target expression: にほかならない. Intended meaning: An emphatic identification of the essential cause. Compared alternatives: にすぎない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register. Scoring follows the nuance specified in the question.

n2.day15-scope.question.11.anchor.en: An emphatic identification of the essential cause.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.logic.zh: 前面给出原因或事实，后面得出一个“这样就说得通了”的自然结论。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.logic.en: The reasons or facts given above are followed by a natural conclusion that “it makes sense”.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.connection.zh: 普通形＋わけだ（な形容词／名词：な＋わけだ）

n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.contrast.zh: 不是单纯的「から＝因为」。から只交代原因；わけだ强调听完原因后“我懂了”。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.contrast.en: It's not simply "から = because." から only explains why; わけだ emphasizes the reason "I understand."

n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.translation.zh: 天天都在练啊，怪不得进步这么快。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.0.translation.en: I've been practicing every day. No wonder it's going so fast.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.logic.zh: 根据常识、证据或对人的了解，强烈判断某事绝不可能成立。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.logic.en: A strong judgement based on common sense, evidence or knowledge of the human person is that something can never be established.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.connection.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な・である／名词＋の・である＋わけがない（名词接な的用例也存在）
n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.connection.en: Verb/i-adjective plain form; na-adjective stem + な or である; noun + の or である; then わけがない. Noun + な also occurs.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.contrast.zh: 「はずがない」也表示不可能；わけがない更像直接反驳“哪有这种道理”，语气往往更强。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.contrast.en: "はずがない" also indicates that it is not possible; わけがない is more like a direct rebuttal of "how can there be such a reason?"

n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.translation.zh: 他怎么可能忘记那种约定。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.1.translation.en: How could he forget that deal?

n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.logic.zh: 承认一部分事实，但否定别人可能顺势推出来的整体结论。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.logic.en: Recognition of part of the facts, but rejection of the overall conclusion that others might be inclined to do so.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.connection.zh: 普通形＋わけではない（な形容词／名词：な＋わけではない）
n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.connection.en: plain form＋わけではない（na-adjective／noun：な＋わけではない）

n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.contrast.zh: 不是全盘否定。常见潜台词是“A 是 A，但也没到 B 那种程度”。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.2.contrast.en: Not totally negative. The usual subterfuge is "A is A, but not to the level of B."

n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.logic.zh: 把前面的整件事或一种说法引用出来，再否定它必然导向某个结论。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.logic.en: To quote the whole thing or a statement from before, to deny it necessarily leads to a conclusion.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.connection.zh: 普通形＋というわけではない（名词／な形容词也可接だ）
n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.connection.en: plain form＋というわけではない（noun／na-adjective also 可接だ）

n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.contrast.zh: 和「わけではない」核心相同，但更适合否定一整套说法、因果推论或概括，中文常用“并不意味着”。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.contrast.en: The same core as the "わけではない" but better suited to negate a whole set of narratives, causal inferences or generalizations, which is commonly used in Chinese “does not mean”.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.translation.zh: 贵并不意味着质量就一定好。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.3.translation.en: Precious doesn't mean quality is always good.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.logic.zh: 能力上做得到，但受到责任、身份、承诺或社会情理约束，不能去做。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.logic.en: It is capable of doing, but it is bound by responsibility, identity, commitment or social reason and cannot do so.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.connection.zh: 动词辞书形＋わけにはいかない
n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.connection.en: verb dictionary form＋わけにはいかない

n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.contrast.zh: 「できない」是客观上做不到；わけにはいかない是“做得到，但我这个立场不能做”。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.contrast.en: "できない" is not objectively possible; わけにはいかない is "can do, but I cannot do this position."

n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.translation.zh: 重要考试就在眼前，我可不能跑去玩。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.4.translation.en: I can't run for the big exam right now.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.logic.zh: “不做”这件事在情理上行不通，所以最后只能做。是带责任感的双重否定。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.logic.en: It's a double denial with a sense of responsibility.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.connection.zh: 动词ない形＋わけにはいかない
n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.connection.en: verb nai-form＋わけにはいかない

n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.contrast.zh: 「なければならない」是一般义务；ないわけにはいかない更突出具体处境逼着自己“不能不做”。
n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.contrast.en: "なければならない " is a general obligation; ないわけにはいかない highlights the specific circumstances that force me to “do nothing”.

n2.day2-wake.grammar.5.translation.zh: 既然人家邀请了，我也不能不去。
